column1: # status values: no_test, pending, fail, timeout, error, ok, unsupported, semantic, codegen, isa, runtime, object, link, loader, obsolete
# unsupported = CPU/ISA does not support the specific feature under test.
# error = compiler/ICE/compile failure occurred during the run step.
# fail = testcase is in the compile/check queue or currently failing before a run.
# timeout = runtime timeout confirmed or conservatively preserved from the latest focused timeout recheck.
# no_test = C testcase is missing, empty, placeholder, or not coverage-reviewed yet.
# ok = testcase compiled/checked successfully for the current pass.
# semantic = slow runtime semantic test pending; skipped by fast make check.
# sem/runtime/run are accepted aliases for semantic in the semantic runner.
# pending = coverage exists and is queued for compile/runtime review; replaces obsolete no_ref.
# base profile = conservative userland output intended for PDP-6, KA10, and KI10; pdp10 profile excludes PDP-6 and is KA/KI portable.
